strategic_foundation.data_insight: LD-CN-GIFT-MOMENT produced 1 of the account's 2 purchases on $107.24 ad spend (male 25-34, 2026-06-21) — the best purchase-per-dollar signal in a pre-signal account ($1,651.69 / 2 purchases, 61% of spend under Incremental attribution). The signal is directional, not proven: this brief exists to validate it under clean test conditions.
strategic_foundation.performance_benchmark: Historical single-purchase read: CPA $107.24 (not decision-grade). Target: any cell producing a purchase below that benchmark at unified 7DC/1DV attribution; >= 30 purchases per read for a real verdict.

testing_framework.matrix_position: Full 3x3 gift-moment MST (cycle 1) — hook axis x concept-staging axis, single copy variant per cell
testing_framework.matrix_naming_convention: LD_GIFT_{HOOK}_{STAGING}_001 — hooks: STORY (Story/Shock), QUESTION, STAT; stagings: KITCHEN (kitchen gift scene), UNWRAP (unwrap moment), REACTION (recipient reaction)
testing_framework.isolated_variable: Hook type (HK_Story/Shock vs HK_Question vs HK_Stat) x concept staging (kitchen gift scene vs unwrap moment vs recipient reaction). Copy architecture, design system, CTA and street-name personalization held constant across all 9 cells.
testing_framework.success_criteria: Any cell CPA below the $107.24 historical benchmark at reconciled attribution; >= 30 purchases per read window before scale/kill calls
testing_framework.learning_objective: Which hook x staging combination carries the gift-moment narrative — and does Advantage+ re-find 25-34 gift buyers when creative speaks to them (52% of historical spend skewed 55+)?

creative_specifications.placement: Broad (Advantage+) — placement metrics were empty in the historical export, so no placement strategy is data-backed yet
creative_specifications.safe_zones: Standard Meta safe zones for Stories/Reels text
creative_specifications.production_requirements: Warm domestic scenes (LD-DS-WARM-LIFESTYLE), single framed street print as hero object, precisely-named real street visible in the artwork, recipient present or implied per staging axis

copy_architecture.hook: Axis under test — STORY: recipient-reaction narrative ('made a grown man cry' lineage); QUESTION: gift-anxiety opener ('Still hunting for a gift that means something?'); STAT: social momentum ('100 dads already have one. Does yours?')
copy_architecture.problem_agitation_or_value_setup: Generic gifts fall flat — the fear of giving something forgettable
copy_architecture.product_solution: Any American street as a museum-quality framed print: the block they grew up on, where life-changing moments happened
copy_architecture.proof: Narrative proof (recipient reaction) + 4.9-star / 450+ reviews trust bar as a constant footer element
copy_architecture.cta: Find their city (implicit personalization prompt, constant across all cells)

visual_direction.composition: Single print staged in a warm domestic scene; staging axis varies the scene (kitchen counter / mid-unwrap / recipient reacting), everything else constant
visual_direction.color_palette: Warm naturals, wood frame tones, soft daylight
visual_direction.typography: Short emotional headline, 2-4 lines of body copy maximum
visual_direction.imagery: Real streets with legible names; no discount overlays, no price flashes
avoid_list: Catalog grids and multi-print spreads (separate LD-H2 test lane)
More than one primary text per cell — historical copy fragmentation (15-29 variants/ad) destroyed isolation

production_checklist: One primary text per cell — no Advantage+ text variant expansion
Isolated variables (hook, staging) clearly executed; all other elements match across cells
Precisely-named street legible in every asset
Unified 7DC/1DV attribution on the campaign before launch
qa_requirements: Copy-to-variable alignment scored per cell before launch
Row/column consistency checked: same staging across a row, same hook down a column
Confirm no discount language leaked into any cell
Human approval before launch — no live account changes without client sign-off

performance_tracking.campaign_structure: Single MST campaign, 9 ad sets (one per cell), broad delivery, standard attribution
performance_tracking.budget_allocation: Within the 60% validate allocation; no cell above 5% of account budget per IAP validate rules
performance_tracking.timeline: 14-day read windows; evaluate only after attribution reconciliation against server-side purchase counts

decision_rules.scale_if: Cell produces purchases below the $107.24 benchmark CPA at >= 30 reconciled purchases
decision_rules.iterate_if: Purchase signal exists but above benchmark — iterate staging within the winning hook column
decision_rules.kill_if: No cell produces a purchase at 2x benchmark spend — fall back to the product-spread lane (LD-H2) as primary direction
